src: const k = sketch('top'); k.circle(40); const t = extrude(k, 30); const sk = sketch('front', -2.6); sk.rect(8.3, 3.8, { at: [18.1, 13.1] }); groove(sk, t, 270);

brep.refused: groove groove1: the ring is spun about the normal of its sketch, which crosses the axis of pull1's round wall -- sketch the ring on a plane square to that axis (the top plane for an upright post) -- groove1 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): a part turn of a ring that reaches the curved outside of a round part, or of a part with several round surfaces, takes a minute or more to cut here, so it is not built; turn the ring a full 360 degrees on the part's own axis, or keep it clear of the round outside wall
